scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build:full: pnpm run build:application && pnpm run build:sites
scripts.build:application: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --if-present run build
scripts.test:front-office: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:front-office && pnpm --filter @workspace/alpha-crm-sync run test:front-office
scripts.test:full: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:front-office && pnpm run test:security && pnpm run test:sites
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --filter @workspace/sites-control --if-present run typecheck
